name: Post with revenue chip
oneLiner: on warm paper a white social post (the brand's face, name, the line) rises in slow 3D; a selection highlight sweeps across the key phrase word by word, then a revenue chip slides out from under the post, swings down and snaps onto its corner: the number counts up, a green line draws and a green change pill lands with a pulse
say: when the speaker reads out a win someone posted and what it earned ('she posted this on Friday, and look what it made'): the highlight sweeps on the line they quote, the chip snaps on the number. Set text, phrase (part of it), amount, prefix and change
